title: Social Media & Content Strategist
description:
**Start with the idea. The calendar comes later.**

Idea to Edit is a creative and production agency. We work with established brands in the US, including automotive, industrial, jewelry, and professional services, and we handle the whole thing: concept, shoot, edit, and ads. Our Gandhinagar team does post-production, design, and social content.

We need one person who owns the thinking that comes before all of it.

**Salary:**
₹40,000 to ₹50,000 per month, paid every 15 days

**Your first job is coming up with ideas that work. That means:**

* Reel ads and short videos with a hook that holds attention
* Carousel ad creatives, static posts, and posters
* Banners and billboard concepts, written clearly enough for a designer to build
* Ideas built from existing footage, turning one shoot into many pieces of content
* Pitch decks and proposals that show a client what the idea will do for their business

From there you’ll write the briefs, work with the editors and designers to get the pieces made, and plan the content calendar around what’s working.

**What you bring**

* 2 to 4 years of experience in social media, content, or ad creative
* Working knowledge of video editing, graphic design, and copywriting
* Hands-on understanding of Google Ads and Meta Ads, and how they bring in customers
* A creative vision you can explain in plain language, with a reason behind every idea
* Comfort working from a brief and a deadline, and with a team that needs direction
* A willingness to learn how to get finished work out of people. We’ll train you on that.

**What we offer**

* ₹40,000 to ₹50,000 per month, based on experience and the trial task
* Paid every 15 days
* Direct training from the founder on creative direction, client thinking, and production
* A small team that moves fast and sees its work go live

**How to apply**

Email your resume to
**info@ideatoedit.com**
. Include a link to your best piece of work and a short note on why it worked.

In the subject line, write exactly:
**Ideas Before Calendars**

We won’t review applications without that subject line. It’s the quickest way to show you read the whole post.
